name: Profit-08
author: sd88me
summary: Eight-voice, two-layer analog-style synthesizer: stack and split layers, a gated sequencer and arpeggiator, a resonant 2/4-pole filter, and a banks browser with favourites for your own program and bank SysEx dumps. 2.0 adds a native MPC screen with large knobs and Q-Link control of every page.
